## Synopsis

Uploads every PolicySet document in the -f files to the server, which validates
each one. A set the server does not have yet is stored off and governs nothing.
For a set that is already live, the upload is stored as edits and
the published version keeps deciding. `strazactl policy list` shows such a set
as Live, edits not published, until `strazactl policy activate <name>` checks the
edits and publishes them.

```
strazactl policy apply [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl policy apply -f local-tools-guardrails.yaml
  strazactl policy activate local-tools-guardrails
```

## Options

```
  -f, --file stringArray   PolicySet YAML file (repeatable)
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
